//: Pyright's settings for the reference package. A dedicated file rather than a
[tool.pyright] table in pyproject.toml, for the reason that file states: tool
tables there are resolved from the nearest ancestor and would silently govern
everything beneath this directory. Pyright reads this file only when this tree
is the project root, which is exactly the scope wanted.
TYPE-001 asks for a strict checker, and strict is where the rule has teeth --
in standard mode an untyped def is accepted in silence, which is the case the
rule exists to refuse. A second checker beside mypy is OPEN-005's decision: a
claim that survives both is stronger than one that survives either.
